news.title: My First Paper Work Published by ACS Nano
news.excerpt: We developed a stretchable mesh electrode array integrated with graphene microneedles to overcome the challenge of interfacing with 3D neural organoids. Fabricated via a low-cost microfluidic patterning technique, this device withstands 200% strain, ensures stable electrode-tissue contact, and enables robust multisite recording—achieving over 60% channel activation and outperforming conventional 2D electrodes.

news.title: A Talk About My Research: 2 Years of Work and Recent Progress
news.excerpt: How can we better collect the electrical signals of miniature human brains in a dish? Over the past two years, my research has been dedicated to solving this by creating flexible, mesh-based interfaces. My presentation at the SUSTech Open Meeting shared this journey—from an initial concept that improved upon rigid electrodes and finally to our latest MESH-GRIP innovation that secures organoids for stable, long-term recording.

news.title: First sea fishing experience
news.excerpt: 🌊During the National Day holiday, I unlocked my first sea fishing experience in my life! I was extremely lucky and caught blue mackerel scad and rabbitfish. I also came across a stunning seaside sunset. Now, my mind is filled with anticipation for the next sea trip.🐟
